# Decisions log

_Template. `/architecture`, `/adopt` and `/customize-kit` create the log from it at the path the **Decisions** row of the "Project docs" table in `CLAUDE.md` names, with the ID prefix that row gives (default `D-`)._

Settled decisions. Claude must not reopen or work against these unless the user asks. To change one, add a new row that supersedes it ("Supersedes D-004") rather than editing the old row.

| ID | Date | Decision | Why | Rejected alternatives | Revisit if |
|----|------|----------|-----|-----------------------|------------|
| D-001 | YYYY-MM-DD | <what was decided> | <the deciding reason, with a number if there is one> | <option — why not> | <condition that would reopen it> |
